title: Cesar demands $10,000 to talk to RFK Jr.

tellings.quote: I've talked to Bobby about it and Bobby was going to go be meeting with the fellow to try to get him to do it and the guy insisted upon being paid you know $110,000

plain: A man called Cesar is said to have demanded money, ten thousand dollars by the story's title though the spoken words sound like more, before he would talk to Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the son of the murdered senator Robert Kennedy. Dan Sheehan, a guest presented as someone tied up in many of America's famous conspiracy cases, says he talked to Kennedy about it and that Kennedy was going to meet the man to get him to talk, but the man insisted on being paid.
